A board can be exported, generating a line of text which can be imported
in external sites, like [Sudoku
solutions](https://www.sudoku-solutions.com/)

``` python
b = Board(board)
b.export()
```

``` python
b = Board(board)
b.solve()
```

``` python
b = Board(board)
b.solve(True)
```

fails:
